summary: Generates BPM-synchronized ramps, pulses, counters, bar/beat/sixteenth channels, and related timing outputs for rhythmic control systems.

key_params.name: playmode
key_params.note: Locked-to-timeline, locked-to-global, or local sequential timing

key_params.name: resetcondition
key_params.note: Input edge/level condition that resets timing

key_params.name: resetwait
key_params.note: Wait after reset until next bar

key_concepts: Beat Dialog and global tempo source
Locked to Timeline, Locked to Global, and Local Sequential play modes
period and multiples for delayed ramps
common_gotchas: Play mode determines whether timing follows the timeline, global beat, or local sequential state.
Reset behavior can hold channels at zero depending on Wait After Reset.
Generated ramps and pulses are control signals, not audio-rate oscillators.
Use Ableton Link CHOP when beat timing should follow external Link peers.
